title: Mark Twain's birth chart
metaDescription: Mark Twain's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 7.9° Sagittarius. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Mars and Pluto sit 0.2° from an exact trine — near enough that the tradition reads drive and depth as a single working part. The scheme reads trines as water finding its level: effortless, and invisible to the person living it.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: Sagittarius, but precisely: 7.9°, first decan, 0°–10°, under Jupiter in the triplicity scheme. The tradition kept these divisions because thirty degrees is a long street.

blocks.title: Closer to the ground
blocks.text: For the fast movers, Mercury was at 19.2° Scorpio, Venus was at 22.1° Sagittarius, Mars was at 13.2° Sagittarius. Read together: a mind that absorbs before it argues; taste that runs toward the vivid and the immediate; drive that ignites on contact.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The day's firmest angle joins Mars and Pluto — a trine holding at 0.2°. Trines are read as inheritance rather than achievement: the ease is genuine, and nothing about it was earned. Behind it, Saturn square Neptune at 0.8°, and Jupiter square Pluto at 1.8° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. These are the day-proof angles — present at midnight, present at noon, present at the next midnight.

blocks.title: What the angles build
blocks.text: The Moon stands apart from every major angle the day held — the tradition reads an unaspected planet as a voice that speaks on its own schedule, unmodulated by the rest of the chart.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: One planet here sits in a sign the classical scheme scores. Jupiter in Cancer at 14.7° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best. The old table grades terrain, not talent — a placement in fall works uphill, nothing more.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: The honest balance sheet uses the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: fire 5, water 3, air 2 across the elements, and fixed 4, mutable 3, cardinal 3 across the modalities. A fire emphasis is read as appetite for the first move, with information gathered by doing rather than before doing. No settled placement falls in earth — an absence the tradition treats as information, not as a defect. Jupiter and Pluto were retrograde — the optical reversal the tradition reads as review — energy turned over before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Aries for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 12.1° between midnight and midnight. Whatever the unrecorded hour was, it happened inside one Moon sign — the degree floats, the sign holds. At the noon reference it stands at 19.3°.
